title: 16142 WEST ROYAL OAK ROAD; BOARD FILE NO. 260047
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
16142 WEST ROYAL OAK ROAD; BOARD FILE NO. 260047
  C.D.: 4 (Councilmember Nithya Raman); Encino – Tarzana Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Justin Brand
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  GA Engineering Inc

  Consideration of Application to export 1,580 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Sections 15303
  (Class 3) and 15332 (Class 32) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines
  (Case No. ENV-2026-429-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an
  exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
summary: Consideration of application to export 1,580 cubic yards of earth from 16142 West Royal Oak Road in Encino, with CEQA categorical exemption review.
